Hi Sam (BlueCrest),

We’re running a 3-day onsite workshop in San Francisco (Jun 12-14) for our customer Acme Financial and need a consolidated ground-transport plan. High-level requirements below — can you turn this into a firm quote and proposed manifest by EOD Monday?

Headcount & ask (approx):
- 40 workshop attendees arriving Jun 12 (most daytime arrivals)
- 3 execs require VIP sedan meet-&-greet at SFO (Tues, 09:00)
- 4 onsite engineers need short-term rental cars for Jun 12–14 (airport pickup/drop)
- 2 shuttle runs morning/evening between hotel and customer site (12–14) for 40 pax
- Overnight parking passes for 8 vehicles at the venue hotel for vendor staff

Key constraints:
- Budget target: keep ground spend under $15k if possible
- Need COI and W-9 before vendor onboarding
- Some attendees will use rideshare (we may provide credits) — want BlueCrest to coordinate overflow on-demand rides if shuttles are late
I’ve attached the headcount spreadsheet and a site parking map. Please include: option A (shuttle + 3 sedans + parking), option B (rideshare credits + fewer shuttles), and separate line item for rental car hold. Also include cancellation policy and lead time for parking permits.

Thanks — quick turnaround appreciated.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SFO-workshop-headcount.xlsx, site-map-parking.png

Karthik — thanks for the details. Quick read of your asks below and a high-level proposal (attached).

Summary (provisional):
- Option A (recommended): 2x 24-passenger shuttles (AM/PM rotations) + 3x black sedan VIP meet & greet at SFO + 8 overnight parking permits at Hilton Union Square: $12,400
- Option B (cost-saver): 1 shuttle + on-demand rideshare coordination & $3,000 in ride credits (capped): $8,900
- Rental car hold (4 midsize SUVs) through our rental partner: $1,050 for three days (includes airport pickup)

Notes:
- Parking permits for the Hilton require a 21-day lead time for preferred lot; we can request a temporary block sooner but rate may be higher.
- COI and business license provided on request; we’ll add background-check verification for VIP drivers at no additional fee.
- Attached: BlueCrest-proposal-20250518.pdf (detailed price list + sample SOW)

If you want, we can provisionally block vehicles pending PO. Let me know which option you want us to hold.

Regards,
Sam Torres
Operations Manager
BlueCrest Car Services
